analyst_view.overall: Early view: Hajduk beat Ajax and won at Thun, then lost 1-0 in Gibraltar to Lincoln Red Imps, with no shot on target until the 85th minute. Nordsjaelland are winless in Europe (two draws and a 2-0 loss at Monaco) but scored six at Randers in the league on 8 November. Hajduk are on six points and one more win would put them close to the top 24.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. Hajduk were blunt in Gibraltar and missed Adrion Pajaziti, Leander Dendoncker, Roko Brajkovic and goalkeeper Ivica Ivusic, while Nordsjaelland managed one attempt at Monaco but score freely at home in Denmark. Those pull in different directions, so I stay with the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners. Nothing in the reports points away from that, so I stay with it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards, already high, which fits a loud Poljud and a home side under pressure after the Lincoln defeat. The referee is not known yet, so I do not push it higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.8 shots. Hajduk took plenty of long-range shots through Dalisson in Gibraltar, which keeps shot counts up even when chances are poor, so I stay with the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Hajduk had one shot on target in 90 minutes against Lincoln, with Dalisson and Soticek missing the target, and Nordsjaelland did not test Lukas Hradecky at Monaco.
